misconception_description: Student believes that variable identifiers can only be one letter long.

solutions.generated_code:
program PanjangKataTerpanjang
kamus
  n, i, m, s : integer
  k : string
algoritma
  input(n)
  m <- 0
  for i <- 1 to n do
    input(k)
    s <- panjang(k)
    if s > m then
      m <- s
    endif
  endfor
  output(m)
endprogram
